description: Hotmaps provides an online toolbox for heating and cooling planning. Its documented calculation modules estimate demand, heat-supply potential, district-heating areas and alternative supply scenarios. The current homepage announces that its layers and modules have moved to Citiwatts. The provider is Hotmaps project consortium. Coverage: The documentation describes European coverage at local through national scales. Resolution depends on the chosen dataset and calculation module; there is no single simulation period. Access: The legacy wiki remains readable and explains the web interface, data handling and calculation modules. The homepage supplies the migration route to Citiwatts. Licence and cost: The wiki describes the software as open source. Its exact software licence and the terms for each underlying dataset must be checked separately. Limitations: The former service has migrated. No claim is made that the historical web application remains operational or that every migrated module was tested. For infrastructure simulation, the modules support heat-demand estimation and district-energy planning scenarios. Related resources: Related records data-hotmaps-electricity-district-heating-scenarios and data-hotmaps-building-stock-and-heat-density-maps describe parts of its data inputs; neither covers the software itself.
